summary: Quiet cul-de-sac kerb backing onto bush; no parking habit and steep.
reasons: Backs onto bush, nearest homes 25 m or more

best_section.where: South kerb at the bottom of Hoylake Street, below the pool house where the road opens out

drivers.seclusion: Kerb backs onto a wooded bank; mapped dwellings 35 m (at 68 m) and 53 m away, with one house 20 m off at the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street widens at the bend; room beside the lane appears enough for a van but is not clear under trees.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parked cars seen; a van would stand out on a quiet street.

flags: Steep: about 6.5% at the best section, 18% max over the stretch
Quiet residential street with no parking convention
Mapped gates and bollard 136-192 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the south side from the morning; open to the afternoon sun from the west near the junction.
